verdict.rationale: First-party material describes in-product AI insights. Productboard automatically detects insights in feedback and suggests links to related feature ideas, surfaces feedback trends with citations for every finding, and has a built-in agent that synthesizes information. Spark adds natural-language querying of connected data such as Amplitude. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the insight and suggestion features work, independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail beyond homepage marketing claims.
